```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02"),
  funs = c("report_format"),
  packages = c("here", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "scales", "dampack"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
base_psa_file <- psa_obj_path()
base_psa <- if (file.exists(base_psa_file)) readRDS(base_psa_file) else NULL

scenario_file <- scenario_evppi_path()
if (!file.exists(scenario_file)) {
  stop(
    "Full scenario cache not found: ", scenario_file, ". Run ",
    "analysis/12_scenario_EVPPIs.R before rendering Figure 4."
  )
}
scenario_cache <- readRDS(scenario_file)

biosimilar_psa <- tryCatch(
  scenario_cache$all_scenario_results$s1_decreased_nivo$psa_obj,
  error = function(e) NULL
)

# The grid carries the base-case WTP as an evaluated point, so the dotted
# reference line meets the curves at a computed value (issue #157).
wtp_range <- sort(unique(c(seq(0, 150000, by = 2000), WTP)))
get_ceac_data <- function(psa, scenario) {
  if (is.null(psa)) return(data.frame())
  result <- dampack::ceac(wtp = wtp_range, psa = psa)
  result$Scenario <- scenario
  # dampack returns Strategy as a factor: labels are looked up by name through
  # strategy_label(), never by factor code (issue #157).
  result %>%
    filter(as.character(Strategy) %in% names(strategy_labels)) %>%
    mutate(Strategy = factor(strategy_label(Strategy),
                             levels = unname(strategy_labels)))
}

base_ceac_data <- get_ceac_data(base_psa, "Base case")
biosimilar_ceac_data <- get_ceac_data(biosimilar_psa, "Biosimilar pricing")
ceac_data <- rbind(base_ceac_data, biosimilar_ceac_data)

make_ceac_plot <- function(data, linewidth, facet = FALSE, show_100k = FALSE) {
  result <- ggplot(data, aes(x = WTP, y = Proportion, color = Strategy)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = linewidth) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = WTP, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray40") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = "EUR ", scale = 0.001,
                                                       suffix = "K")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Standard of Care" = "gray50",
                                  "CRP-guided" = "#E69F00",
                                  "TMB/BRAF-guided" = "#0072B2")) +
    labs(x = "Willingness-to-pay threshold (EUR/QALY)",
         y = "Probability cost-effective",
         color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  if (facet) result <- result + facet_wrap(~Scenario, ncol = 1)
  if (show_100k) {
    result <- result + geom_vline(
      xintercept = 100000,
      linetype = "dotted",
      color = "gray65"
    )
  }
  result
}
```

## Figure 4

```{r figure-4, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
if (nrow(ceac_data) > 0) {
  p_ceac <- make_ceac_plot(ceac_data, linewidth = 0.8, facet = TRUE)
  print(p_ceac)
} else {
  cat("PSA cache not available. Run analysis/10_PSA.R first.")
}
```

## Figure S4

```{r figure-s4, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
if (nrow(base_ceac_data) > 0) {
  p_ceac_s4 <- make_ceac_plot(
    base_ceac_data,
    linewidth = 0.85,
    show_100k = TRUE
  )
  print(p_ceac_s4)
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (exists("p_ceac")) {
  figs_dir <- here("outputs", "figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  ggsave(here("outputs", "figs", "figure4.png"), p_ceac, width = 9, height = 7,
         dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
if (exists("p_ceac_s4")) {
  ggsave(here("outputs", "figs", "figure_s4.png"), p_ceac_s4, width = 9, height = 6,
         dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
```

Figures 4 and S4 have been saved to `outputs/figs/figure4.png` and `outputs/figs/figure_s4.png`.
